rationale: Five of the six applicable criteria are met with evidence in the packet. The unit is 860 sq ft, 60 sq ft above the limit in §ADU-2, and the applicant has requested a variance on accessibility grounds for a family member who uses a wheelchair. A variance is a decision for a reviewer or the review board, not a routine request, so the case needs judgment.
letter:
Dear Thanh Nguyen,

Thank you for your application MIA-2026-1171 for an accessory dwelling unit at 3345 Mango Hill Road, and for your letter requesting a variance. Your documents meet the ADU rules for zoning, setbacks, owner occupancy, and flood elevation. The unit is 860 sq ft, which is 60 sq ft above the 800 sq ft limit in the zoning code (§ADU-2), so your variance request must be decided before a permit can be issued.

To support that decision we need one item:

1. A floor plan of the unit showing the accessible bathroom and bedroom (Zoning code §ADU-2). It lets the reviewer see how the extra 60 sq ft is used. Your contractor, Coral Ridge Construction Inc., can provide it.

[Reviewer to decide: refer the variance to the review board, or ask for a revised plan at 800 sq ft or less.]

Please reply by 5 Oct 2026 through the applicant portal or by email to permits@example.com. Call (305) 555-0100 if you have questions.

Building Department, City of Miami
